items.item_text: Experience in undergraduate admission, higher education marketing, or enrollment communications.
Understanding of the college search process for students entering their senior year.
Experience working with liberal arts colleges or mission-driven organizations.
Experience with email automation, personalization, journey mapping, and A/B testing.
Develop a campaign strategy for high school juniors, with appropriate messaging variations for students and parents.
Create a campaign journey from initial awareness through inquiry, campus visit, event registration, and preparation for the application process.
Write and edit student-centered email, text, web, social, and event communications.
Develop a campaign calendar, message map, audience segments, calls to action, and testing plan.
Lead with Pitzer’s academic experience, community, values, and student outcomes before introducing the benefits of The Claremont Colleges.
Identify opportunities to incorporate authentic student voices, experiences, and stories.
Coordinate with Admission, Communications, faculty, students, and other campus partners to gather content and secure approvals.
Build campaign materials within Slate and MS Planner and provide implementation-ready copy and specifications to the appropriate staff.
Recommend measurable goals for engagement, inquiry conversion, event registration, and continued participation.
Establish a reporting framework and provide optimization recommendations based on early campaign performance.
Deliver organized templates, documentation, and reusable assets that Pitzer staff can maintain after the temporary assignment ends.
Familiarity with Slate or a comparable CRM and communication platform.
Familiarity with accessibility, inclusive communication, and student privacy expectations.
Strong leadership and collaboration skills with a commitment to a team-based work environment.
Natural aptitude for technology and expertise with MS Office, including expert level use of Excel.
Ability to problem-solve and use analytical skills to develop and implement creative solutions.
Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
Ability to take initiative to work proactively, meet deadlines, organize and prioritize multiple projects, think strategically, and work with numbers and data.
Exhibit personal integrity and ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information.
Exhibit a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and sound professional judgment.
Demonstrated experience developing multichannel marketing, enrollment, fundraising, or audience-engagement campaigns.
Strong writing and editing skills, particularly for student, family, or consumer audiences.
Ability to translate institutional priorities into clear, compelling, audience-centered communications.
Experience developing campaign calendars, audience segments, calls to action, and performance measures.
Ability to manage a defined project independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and consistent attention to deadlines and details.
